coreMemory.chinese: 穿着；戴着；佩着；面带；呈现；磨损；用坏
coreMemory.english: v. to have clothing, jewelry, or another item on your body；v. to have a particular expression or appearance；v. to become thinner, weaker, or damaged through use
coreMemory.structure: wear a coat /ˈwɛr ə ˈkoʊt/（穿外套）；wear glasses /ˈwɛr ˈɡlæsəz/（戴眼镜）；wear a helmet /ˈwɛr ə ˈhɛlmət/（戴头盔）；wear a uniform /ˈwɛr ə ˈjuːnəˌfɔːrm/（穿制服）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ She is wearing on a red coat. → ✅ She is wearing a red coat.；❌ He has wore glasses since childhood. → ✅ He has worn glasses since childhood.

commonErrors.wrong: She is wearing on a red coat.
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /ˈʃiː ˈɪz ˈwɛrɪŋ ˈɑn ə ˈrɛd ˈkoʊt/
commonErrors.right: She is wearing a red coat.
commonErrors.note: wear 表示穿着时直接接衣物，不加 on。

commonErrors.wrong: He has wore glasses since childhood.
commonErrors.right: He has worn glasses since childhood.
commonErrors.note: 现在完成时 has 后要用过去分词 worn，不能用过去式 wore。

coreMemory.directSynonym: have on /ˈhæv ˈɑn/（穿着；戴着）；don /ˈdɑn/（穿上）；sport /ˈspɔːrt/（醒目地穿戴）；bear /ˈbɛr/（带有）；display /dɪˈspleɪ/（显露）
coreMemory.directAntonym: remove /riˈmuːv/（脱下；摘下）；conceal /kənˈsiːl/（掩饰；隐藏）；preserve /prəˈzɝːv/（保护；使免于磨损）
coreMemory.example: Wear a warm coat because it is cold outside.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 外面很冷，请穿件暖和的外套。

meanings.english: to have clothing, jewelry, or another item on your body
meanings.example: She wore a blue jacket to the interview.
meanings.translation: 她穿着蓝色夹克参加面试。

meanings.english: to have a particular expression or appearance
to become thinner, weaker, or damaged through use
meanings.example: The carpet has worn badly near the door.
meanings.translation: 门边的地毯磨损得很厉害。

items.phrase: wear traditional dress at the ceremony
wear a seat belt at all times
items.phonetic: /ˈwɛr ə ˈsiːt ˈbɛlt ˈæt ˈɔːl ˈtaɪmz/

items.phrase: wear ear protection in the factory
quality denim wears better than cheap fabric
items.phonetic: /ˈkwɑləti ˈdɛnəm ˈwɛrz ˈbɛtɚ ˈðæn ˈtʃiːp ˈfæbrɪk/
items.chinese: 优质牛仔布比廉价面料更耐穿

fixedPhrases.example: Wear a warm coat because temperatures will fall tonight.
fixedPhrases.translation: 穿件暖和的外套吧，今晚会降温。

fixedPhrases.example: She wears glasses only when reading small print.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她只有看小字时才戴眼镜。

fixedPhrases.example: Every rider must wear a helmet on the construction site.
fixedPhrases.translation: 施工现场的每名骑行者都必须戴头盔。

fixedPhrases.example: Hotel staff wear a dark blue uniform.
fixedPhrases.translation: 酒店员工穿深蓝色制服。

fixedPhrases.example: Despite the delay, the receptionist still wore a welcoming smile.
fixedPhrases.translation: 尽管出现延误，接待员仍面带亲切的微笑。

fixedPhrases.example: She rarely wears makeup outside formal events.
fixedPhrases.translation: 除正式场合外，她很少化妆。

fixedPhrases.example: Passengers must wear a seat belt while the vehicle is moving.
fixedPhrases.translation: 车辆行驶时，乘客必须系安全带。

fixedPhrases.example: These leather boots wear well even in wet weather.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这双皮靴即使在潮湿天气里也很耐穿。

fixedPhrases.example: After the third unexplained delay, everyone's patience was wearing thin.
fixedPhrases.translation: 第三次无故延误后，大家都快失去耐心了。

fixedPhrases.example: Years of wind and rain wore away the carved lettering.
fixedPhrases.translation: 多年的风吹雨打磨掉了雕刻的文字。

fixedPhrases.example: Walking ten kilometers to work every day quickly wore out his shoes.
fixedPhrases.translation: 每天步行十公里上班很快就把他的鞋穿坏了。

fixedPhrases.example: She has worn her hair short since joining the swimming team.
fixedPhrases.translation: 自从加入游泳队以来，她一直留短发。

synonyms.difference: 口语，强调当前穿戴状态；wear 也描述习惯或一般穿戴，不只当前状态。
正式，强调穿上的动作；wear 强调穿戴后的状态，don 只强调穿上的动作。
常暗示自豪地展示某物；wear 语气中性，不含刻意炫耀意味。
只对应面容带有表情或标记；wear 还能接衣物、饰品或磨损主语，不限面部特征。
对应显露表情、特征，不用于普通衣物；wear 是穿戴衣物的常规动词，display 不能这样替换。

antonyms.usage: 只与穿戴衣物或配饰的义项相对；wear 表示把衣物留在身上，remove 表示将其脱下或取下。
只与 wear/display an expression 的显露义相对；conceal 表示不让同一感情或态度显现出来。
只与 use wears something down/out 的磨损义相对；preserve 表示避免同一物品损耗。

derivatives.note: 指正在穿着或佩戴某件衣物、设备或饰品的人。
作名词常指智能穿戴设备，作形容词表示适合穿戴。
常形容旧物磨损，也可形容人显得疲惫。

confusables.difference: 两词发音相同，wear 表示穿戴，where 表示地点
wear、where 和 ware 都读 /wɛr/；ware 是“制品、器皿”，通常出现在 software、tableware 等词中。
